measurement-methodology-drift.hook: A cited self-reported number (tokens/cost/etc.) survives leaf-node verification against its named source, but a LATER, more rigorous measurement from the same project quietly proves the counting method was wrong — the citation is accurate and the number is still stale

metric-conflation.title: pattern_metric_conflation_and_traceable_not_verified.md
metric-conflation.hook: Two citation-lens patterns — a "success band" whose endpoints are two DIFFERENT metrics, and "closed-as-traceable" conflating paper-traceability with digit-verification

metric-conflation.title: pattern_risk_grading_conflations.md
metric-conflation.hook: Recurring logic gaps in research risk matrices — likelihood/success conflation and keystone-on-unverified-evidence

missing-root-invariant.title: pattern_missing_root_invariant.md
missing-root-invariant.hook: When successive rounds each patch one security gate and each patch spawns a next-order gap, the root cause is a missing stated invariant — surface the invariant, not just the Nth instance

causal-narrative-fails-reproduction.title: pattern_postmortem_misdiagnosis.md
causal-narrative-fails-reproduction.hook: Corrected figures verify clean while the repair's forensic story of HOW the old number went wrong is itself false — test the claimed error mechanism by reproducing the OLD number under it

causal-narrative-fails-reproduction.title: pattern_unquoted_hold_masks_discrepancy.md
causal-narrative-fails-reproduction.hook: A lens's "checked, held, not raised" entry that asserts a match WITHOUT quoting both sides can mask a live discrepancy; when lenses conflict, the merge seat decides by direct read, never by majority or by trusting the hold

reflexivity-blindspot.title: pattern_reflexivity_blindspot.md
reflexivity-blindspot.hook: report headlines a risk class for its subject matter but never applies it to its own toolchain/pipeline/drafting window — audit the report's own operations against its own findings

unverified-composition.title: pattern_self_defeating_mitigation.md
unverified-composition.hook: A control added to close a prior-round gap introduces its own failure mode — audit every new mitigation as a fresh attack surface, not a closed ticket

unverified-composition.title: pattern_sibling_repair_composition.md
unverified-composition.hook: Two same-round repairs to one design (mechanism hardened, registered test/prediction restated) can fail to compose — re-derive the test from the hardened mechanism

unverified-composition.title: pattern_unreconciled_numeric_floors.md
unverified-composition.hook: Two fixes added in different rounds each set a minimum/allocation over the same shared resource (lane count, agent count, budget); neither cross-references the other's arithmetic

unverified-composition.title: pattern_waiver_graduation_and_closure_amendment.md
unverified-composition.hook: checked-not-raised waivers are class-conditional (promote when the class becomes established); prior CLEAN closures can need amendment when a composition defect between two verified repairs surfaces a round later

within-source-condition-misattribution.title: pattern_within_source_condition_misattribution.md
within-source-condition-misattribution.hook: A correctly-cited paper's headline result quoted with a gloss that silently reassigns it to a weaker experimental condition/arm — especially to justify NOT building the stronger condition; check which arm carries the number
